name: @pipeworx/mcp-repology

tools.name: project
tools.description: All packages (per-repo) for one project name (e.g. "firefox").

tools.name: problems
tools.description: Outstanding maintenance problems for a project.

tools.name: repositories
tools.description: List all package repositories indexed by Repology (distros, BSDs, language ecosystems, etc.) with their names, family, and active/total package counts.

tools.name: maintainer
tools.description: Maintainer summary by canonical maintainer id (often email).

tools.name: projects_search
tools.description: Paginate or filter Repology projects by name substring, maintainer, category, or repository membership; returns up to 200 project names per page with their per-repo version data.

start_name.description: Pagination cursor — project name to start at.

end_name.description: Pagination cursor — project name to end at (reverse).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-repology forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the repology pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
